issues.body:
The added line reads 'The guide's Pages mount discussed in §8 remains open'. In this file §8 is '## 8. What this PR changes' (line 214), which covers the README/introduction.md {{#include}} anchoring and the mdbook-rewrite-links.py uppercase-pattern gap - it does not mention the Pages mount at all. The mount discussion is in §7 ('Rustdoc as the generated bulk, and the one open decision'), heading at line 177, with '**The one genuinely blocked item is the Pages mount**' at line 192 and the (a)/(b) option list following it.

This is self-contradictory within the same block quote: the pre-existing banner text two lines above already uses '§8' correctly for its true referent ('The one code change shipped alongside it is named in §8'). A reader who follows the new pointer lands on the code-change section, finds no mount discussion, and cannot confirm the status claim - which defeats the purpose of a status banner whose whole job is to be checkable. Note the round-2 findings also mis-labelled this as 'Section 8', so the error was likely inherited from the review text rather than the record.
issues.fix_hint: Change '§8' to '§7' in the added line: 'The guide's Pages mount discussed in §7 remains open: `docs.yml` still has no deploy job, and `pages.yml` still records the guide-at-root versus `/guide/` decision as open.'
issues.title: New banner cites the Pages mount as being discussed in §8, but it is §7

issues.body: The added text says 'see the linked runbook's Provenance section', but unlike research/docs-site-single-sourcing-anti-drift.md - whose banner does carry an explicit markdown link to ../docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md - this record never hyperlinks the runbook. It appears only as inline code spans further down (line 69, '(this is the broader Pages-cutover work in `docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md`)' and line 82), both of which are below the banner, so 'the linked runbook' is a forward reference to something that is named but not linked. The path is discoverable, so this is cosmetic only.
issues.fix_hint: Make the reference explicit in the banner, e.g. "see the Provenance section of [`docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md`](../docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md)", mirroring the wording already used in the anti-drift record.
issues.title: 'the linked runbook' has no link in this record's banner

verdict.summary:
Docs-only PR adding a 'Post-record status' banner to two research records. Round 3 rewrites the banner prose, and all three round-2 findings are genuinely fixed, verified against this head.

(1) The round-2 MAJOR on research/dashboard-retirement-assessment.md is resolved. The banner no longer calls the retirement criteria 'historical'; it now states plainly that 'the retirement cutover remains open: bench.yml still publishes the standalone dashboard to benchmark-data, and pages.yml overlays that tree into the site export.' That matches the tree: .github/workflows/bench.yml:630 still sets benchmark-data-dir-path: dev/bench and :725 is still the 'Seed Pages dashboard onto benchmark-data' step, while .github/workflows/pages.yml:266 is still 'Overlay benchmark dashboard(s) (dev/bench*) from benchmark-data'. The record's DO-NOT-RETIRE verdict and the lines 79-81 'actual retirement step' bullet are no longer contradicted.

(2) The round-2 MAJOR on research/docs-site-single-sourcing-anti-drift.md is resolved. The banner now says the guide's Pages mount 'remains open: docs.yml still has no deploy job, and pages.yml still records the guide-at-root versus /guide/ decision as open.' Verified: docs.yml carries the 'WHY IT DOES NOT DEPLOY TO PAGES' block, :112 uploads the guide as 'CI artifact only - NOT a Pages deploy', and no configure-pages/upload-pages-artifact/deploy-pages step exists in that lane; pages.yml:43-44 still leaves the root question undecided.

(3) The round-2 MINOR is resolved. Both banners now carry the runbook's own hedge verbatim in substance - 'complete on the repo side: the producer workflow exists. The Pages service setting is reported as flipped but is not verified here' - matching docs/pages-cutover-runbook.md:9-12 and its Provenance section at :18.

The sq-hsyg closure claim is also true: site/src/components/benchmarks/{trend-charts,scaling-charts,line-chart}.tsx exist and site/scripts/sync-benchmarks.mjs:93 emits a 20-commit his… [truncated 222 chars]
